Releasing fish (+3), picking up litter (+2) and fishing (+1, up to 20 a day per spot) at the same spot deepens its memory of you: Familiar 15 → Close 50 → Old Friend 130 → Guardian 300 → Family of the Sea 600. The deeper the memory, the more glowing plankton on the water, small fish leap out, and fish bite faster (5% at Close, 5% more per level, up to 20%). When you walk up to a spot, its name shows your memory level and points. It doesn't change which fish you catch.
